about.description: Perdido Dunes Tower is a Gulf Shores and Orange Beach vacation destination offering comfortable coastal living and panoramic views of Perdido Bay. A smoke-free vacation tower providing guests with direct access to beach pathways, resort-style amenities, and close proximity to local dining, shopping, and adventure. Each unit blends open-concept living spaces with coastal décor and natural light. Located between Gulf Shores and Orange Beach with easy access to sugar-white Gulf beaches, Perdido Key recreational areas, water sports, fishing charters, community golf, parks, and bike paths.
about.elevator_pitch: Smoke-free Gulf front tower with direct beach access, resort-style amenities, and panoramic Perdido Bay views ideal for families, couples, and groups.
